about.title: A thread that connects us
about.intro: Chère Pochette began with a simple idea: giving forgotten materials a new life, with our own hands.

born.title: How Chère Pochette began
paragraphs: We are seven students at the Cantonal Business School (SCC) in Bellinzona.
Through the Company Programme of YES – Young Enterprise Switzerland, we founded a real mini-company: from the idea to the product, all the way to the sale.

idea.title: The idea: crochet bags
paragraphs: We chose crochet: a patient, handmade craft that leaves room for creativity.
That's how our three models were born: Jolie, Belle and Coquette. The same shapes, yet every bag is different.

materials.title: Clothes and umbrellas, given a second life
paragraphs: The outside is crocheted with fettuccia, a yarn made from recycled clothes.
Broken umbrellas, often thrown away after a single gust of wind, become the lining inside our bags.

women.title: Together with Ukrainian women
paragraphs: Our bags are made in collaboration with a group of Ukrainian women who crochet with us.
We share technique, ideas and time. They are friends with one another – just like the seven of us.

slogan.title: Made to carry on
paragraphs: Our slogan has a double meaning.
“Carry on” is carrying your bag with you, every day. It also means keeping going: giving a future to materials that would otherwise be thrown away.

thread.title: The thread in our logo
paragraphs: The needle and thread stand for handmade work.
The thread is also an invisible bond: it links every bag to the others, and all the women in the project. It's a symbol of our friendship and mutual support.

items.title: Craftsmanship
items.text: Every bag is made by hand, with care and patience.

items.title: Sustainability
items.text: We use what already exists instead of producing something new.

items.title: Reuse
items.text: Forgotten clothes and umbrellas become our raw material.

items.title: Collaboration between women
items.text: We create together and learn from one another.

items.title: Friendship
items.text: The thread that links our bags is the same one that links us.

cta.title: Every bag carries this story on

process.title: From umbrella to bag
process.intro: A broken umbrella, a forgotten piece of clothing. Here's how they become a Chère Pochette, in five steps.

steps.title: Recovery
steps.text: It all starts with what others throw away: broken umbrellas and clothes no one wears anymore.

steps.title: Selection
steps.text: We choose colours, patterns and fabrics that go well together. Every combination is different.

steps.title: Creation
steps.text: Fettuccia, a yarn made from recycled clothes, takes shape stitch by stitch. We crochet together with the Ukrainian women.

steps.title: Lining
steps.text: The umbrella fabric becomes the lining. A different pattern every time – a little surprise when you open the bag.

steps.title: Chère Pochette
steps.text: A numbered, one-of-a-kind piece is born, ready to be carried. Made to carry on.

closing.title: The meaning of “Made to carry on”
closing.text: Carrying a bag – and, at the same time, letting its materials live on. That's what guides every stitch we make.

info.title: Good to know
info.intro: Shipping, pickup, payment and caring for your bag: everything you need to know, in short.

shipping.title: Shipping
paragraphs: We ship with Swiss Post throughout Switzerland and to Liechtenstein.
Flat shipping fee: CHF {fee}
We usually ship within 5 working days of payment. This is an estimate: we pack every parcel with care, in between school lessons.

pickup.title: Pickup in Bellinzona
paragraphs: You can also collect your bag in Bellinzona, free of charge.
After your purchase, we'll contact you to agree on a day, time and place.

payment.title: Payment
paragraphs: You pay securely on Zahls.ch, with TWINT, card or PostFinance.
Your card or account details stay with Zahls.ch: we never see them.
Online payment is not active yet: for now you order your bag by e-mail, straight from its page.
Our confirmation e-mail tells you how to pay.

returns.title: Returns
paragraphs: Every bag is one of a kind, and we want you to be happy with your choice.
If it's not right for you, write to us within 14 days of receiving it. If the bag is unused and in its original condition, you can send it back.
Return shipping is at your expense. Once we receive the bag, we refund its price (the original shipping fee is not refundable).
Did your bag arrive damaged? Write to us right away with a photo and we'll find a solution together.

care.title: Caring for your bag
tips: Hand wash in cold water with a mild detergent.
Don't wring or twist the bag.
Let it dry flat, away from heat sources.
No washing machine, no tumble dryer.

items.a: We use recovered materials, so colours and patterns always vary. And every bag is handmade: small differences are part of its character.
